_comment: Local backend build config - talks to a backend running on the host machine (`npm run dev` in docwellness-backend, port 5000). 10.0.2.2 is the Android emulator's alias for the host loopback; use http://localhost:5000 for a physical device on the same network (swap for the machine's LAN IP) or the iOS simulator. Sentry/PostHog are intentionally omitted so they stay no-ops locally (EnvService defaults them to empty).
